_comment: health-band checks. Feeds: newest bar (bar start + bar_minutes) must be within max_stale_market_min CME Globex minutes (Sun 18:00 -> Fri 17:00 ET, daily halt 17:00-18:00 ET; exchange holidays not modelled). ts: a column name, or 'index' for the parquet's index. forward_pane: the forward-pane collector reused for stale jobs. Gauges (always drawn): lse_calls_log lines dated today (local) out of lse_daily_limit; agent_logs = dispatch.sh logs started today or still running; profile_script's `measure` desc_chars plus user_skills descriptions, /4 = tokens per turn.
